Job Title: Pastry Chef
Salary range: $79,500 - $85,000
Job Closure date: 30 days

About the Role
This is not just a kitchen position; it is a central role in sustaining a beloved local institution. As the Pastry Chef, you will be the creative and operational engine behind the bakery's daily offerings. You will champion the bakery's philosophy of time-honoured techniques and quality at every stage, from sourcing to final presentation. This role requires a unique blend of artistry, leadership, and operational acumen to ensure every product that leaves the kitchen upholds the bakery’s sterling reputation. You will work closely with the management team to nurture a positive, inclusive, and skilled team environment.

Key Duties & Responsibilities

Product Creation & Kitchen Leadership:
· Design, develop, and execute the daily pastry and viennoiserie menu, ensuring alignment with the bakery’s artisanal philosophy and seasonal inspirations.
· Demonstrate and uphold traditional baking techniques, providing hands-on training and guidance to kitchen staff to ensure consistency and excellence in all products, from laminated croissants to naturally leavened breads.
· Oversee all stages of food preparation, presentation, and preservation, implementing best practices for maintaining peak quality and flavour from the bench to the display case.

Operations & Quality Assurance:
· Manage comprehensive kitchen operations including precise ingredient forecasting, inventory control, and strategic ordering of high-quality food supplies.
· Conduct rigorous quality control checks at all critical points, from dough fermentation to final bake, ensuring every item meets the bakery’s exacting standards.
· Analyse food and labour costs in collaboration with management to develop efficient production schedules that support business objectives without compromising craftsmanship.

Team & Compliance Management:
· Participate in the selection and hands-on training of new kitchen staff, fostering a culture of continuous learning, respect, and inclusion.
· Serve as the kitchen’s authority on health and safety, rigorously explaining and enforcing all hygiene and food safety regulations to maintain an impeccable standard.

Skills & Experience Required
· Proven 1-2 years’ experience as a Pastry Chef, preferably within a bakery, artisanal café, or similar fast-paced environment focused on scratch-made production.
· A genuine passion for and deep knowledge of traditional baking methods, ingredient functionality, and pastry arts.
· Demonstrated leadership ability with experience in training, mentoring, and motivating a small team within a collaborative setting.
· Strong organizational and financial skills, with the aptitude to manage kitchen inventories, conduct yield tests, and contribute to cost management.
· Excellent communication skills and the ability to discuss production processes, challenges, and ideas effectively with managers and team members.
· An unwavering commitment to cleanliness, food safety, and upholding the highest standards of quality.
· A proactive, creative, and resilient attitude, aligned with a workplace that values diversity and teamwork.

What Next?
If you are passionate about traditional baking and thrive in a fast-paced, hands-on environment, we would love to hear from you! Apply now to be part of a team that takes pride in crafting exceptional baked goods with care and expertise.

Please note: We are acting as the recruitment agent on behalf of our client, and the employer’s identity will be disclosed upon application.

Cafe All-Rounder / Kiosk Operator — Founding Team
Permanent part-time | 20–30 hours per week. Burwood Chinatown | Regular evenings and weekends. Structured pathway to Shift Leader

About Swish
Swish Japanese Desserts is a new premium dessert and specialty-drinks kiosk opening at Burwood Chinatown. Our primary product is fresh 'taiyaki'—a sweet Japanese fish-shaped pastry with a crisp exterior and custard filled centre. We will also serve matcha, Japanese-inspired drinks, specialty coffee and soft serve. We are building a small founding team that cares about product accuracy, cleanliness, speed and warm customer service.

The opportunity
You will be trained across the complete kiosk operation, including:
- Cooking fresh taiyaki
- Preparing drinks and desserts to exact recipes
- Customer service and POS operation
- Opening and closing procedures
- Cleaning and sanitising

This role has a structured pathway toward Shift Leader for someone who demonstrates reliability, operating discipline and the ability to support other team members.

You will suit this role if you:
- Consistently arrive on time and ready to work
- Learn quickly and follow recipes precisely
- Maintain high cleanliness standards without repeated reminders
- Work calmly and efficiently during busy periods
- Communicate warmly and clearly with customers
- Accept feedback and apply it
- Take ownership of small problems
- Can commit reliably to evening and weekend shifts
- Want to grow into greater responsibility

Hospitality, dessert, bakery, bubble tea, fast-service or customer-service experience is helpful, but attitude, reliability and ability to learn matter just as much.

*Burwood and late-night availability
Swish’s busiest trading periods will include Thursday–Sunday evenings. Applicants must have a reliable and practical way to travel home from Burwood Chinatown after shifts finishing at approximately 11pm. A short and dependable commute is highly regarded.

*Japanese product and cultural fit
Genuine interest in Japanese food culture and a willingness to learn the names, preparation and story of our products accurately are important. Previous Japanese hospitality experience is helpful but not required. We are looking for respectful curiosity—not prior expertise.

*Language skills
Community-language skills—particularly Japanese, Mandarin or Cantonese—are an advantage for serving Burwood’s diverse customer base, but they are not required.
 
What Swish offers:
- Permanent part-time employment
- Award-compliant pay and applicable penalty rates
- Structured product and operational training
- Food-safety training
- Development toward Shift Leader
- A respectful and inclusive workplace
- The opportunity to help shape a new premium hospitality brand

Please submit your resume with the application and answer:
1. What interests you about joining the founding team of Swish?
2. What evening and weekend availability can you consistently commit to?
3. How will you normally travel home after a late shift in Burwood?
4. Choose one Swish product—taiyaki, matcha, hojicha or azuki—and explain what interests you about learning to prepare and describe it accurately.
5. Tell us about a time you had to follow a precise recipe, process or checklist.

Responsibilities include responding to telephone and in-person enquiries, providing accurate information and assistance, directing visitors appropriately, managing appointments and resources, and ensuring clear and professional communication at all times. In addition, the role contributes to the efficient management of business services through data entry, record keeping, and maintenance of both electronic and hardcopy files in line with legislative and organisational requirements. Duties include processing invoices, ordering supplies, supporting IT and help desk functions, and assisting with reporting and compliance activities. The role also supports continuous improvement initiatives, workplace health and safety, and organisational policies, while demonstrating cultural awareness, professional development, and a commitment to quality public sector service delivery.

WHO ARE WE? 

The Barossa Hills Fleurieu Local Health Network offers opportunities across our sites, from Kangaroo Island to Eudunda, wrapping all the way around our metropolitan areas. We pride ourselves on providing exceptional care to all our consumers, residents, their families, and community. Our mission is to ensure that you always receive the best quality, safe, consistent, collaborative care and always with kindness. We do this by maintaining exceptional levels of care at all times supported by systems and processes that assure us of quality and safety of our staff and those we serve.

From heritage streets to riverside walks, boutique shopping and relaxed caf moments, Gawler invites you to slow down, wander a little further, stay a little longer and discover the stories around every corner. Just 43 km north of Adelaide and on the edge of the renowned Barossa Valley, Gawler blends historic charm with vibrant local culture. Planned in 1839 by William Light, the town is rich in character, with grand stone buildings, historic pubs and beautifully preserved streets. Visit Gawler here.

Are you adaptable and proactive, with a willingness to support different teams, learn new systems, and contribute to continuous improvement in a busy service environment?

If you have answered yes to any of these questions - then read on. 

HOW WILL YOU CONTRIBUTE? 

You will....

Provide frontline reception and telephone support by responding to enquiries, directing calls and visitors, and delivering accurate information in a professional and timely manner. 

Deliver a range of administrative and clerical services, including scheduling appointments, managing resources, processing invoices, and supporting general office operations. 

Maintain accurate electronic and hardcopy records by updating, filing, retrieving, and securely managing client and organisational documentation in line with policies and legislation. 

Support internal teams and leadership by assisting with IT troubleshooting, data entry, reporting, and other administrative tasks as required.

Support for you and your family via our free Employee Assistance Program.

OUR COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY & INCLUSION

Specialising in major infrastructure projects and complexity done excellently, Bowhill Engineering is powered by technology and driven by great people to optimise and build structures that matter.


About the Role
The Business Manager will provide leadership, coordination and accountability across our key business support functions, including Human Resources, Administration, WHSE and Finance.
Working closely with the CEO, senior leaders and support teams, you will become the central point of coordination that helps ensure communication is clear, priorities are aligned, systems continue to improve, and important initiatives are delivered successfully.
This role is not about doing everything yourself. It is about leading people, strengthening accountability, improving processes, supporting teams and ensuring the business operates efficiently while maintaining the practical, down-to-earth culture that makes Bowhill Engineering a great place to work.
You will help create the systems, structure and leadership pathways needed to support sustainable growth while preserving the values and culture that have made Bowhill Engineering successful.

About You
You enjoy bringing order to complexity and helping people succeed.
You are practical, organised and commercially minded, with the ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on leadership. You communicate clearly, follow through on commitments and know how to achieve results through collaboration and accountability.
You may come from a business management, operations, HR, finance, administration or leadership background. Most importantly, you understand how businesses operate and can bring people, systems and priorities together to achieve positive outcomes.

-Highly organised, practical and reliable
-A strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills
-Commercially aware with sound financial understanding
-Confident leading people and managing accountability
-Calm under pressure and able to prioritise effectively
-Comfortable working with both senior leaders and frontline teams
-Respectful, humble and solutions-focused
-A proactive problem solver who takes ownership and follows through
-Adaptable and quick to learn new systems and processes

-Proven leadership experience with the ability to coordinate teams and drive accountability
-Experience implementing and improving systems, processes and business initiatives
-Excellent organisational, communication and problem-solving skills

Situated within a modern shopping center, the facility benefits from high foot traffic and state-of-the-art infrastructure, including onsite pathology, the latest clinical software, and seamless digital integration through online booking systems.

An established, doctor-owned, and accredited mixed-billing medical practice in Rockingham, Western Australia, is seeking a qualified General Practitioner to join its patient-focused team. Located approximately 45 minutes from the Perth CBD, this modern clinic operates within a Distribution Priority Area (DPA), making it an eligible and attractive opportunity for GPs under moratorium. The practice offers a vibrant clinical environment equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, advanced technology, and onsite pathology, ensuring a seamless and efficient diagnostic workflow for both doctors and patients. 

 Practitioners are supported by a dedicated, multidisciplinary team comprising experienced administrative staff and skilled nursing professionals who actively assist with care plans and Chronic Disease Management (CDM). This comprehensive support structure ensures that GPs can focus primarily on patient care while maintaining full clinical autonomy. The practice caters to a diverse demographic, offering ample scope for incoming doctors to pursue and develop special interest opportunities. For those interested in medical education, the practice environment offers a supportive platform for future supervisor opportunities to mentor registrars and medical students. 

 The role prioritizes a healthy work-life balance, featuring flexible working arrangements with a weekday schedule from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM and absolutely no callouts. Financially, the position offers a high percentage of billings alongside a negotiable initial guaranteed payment for the first three months. Continuous Professional Development (CPD) is highly encouraged and supported to facilitate ongoing career growth. Beyond the clinic walls, the Rockingham location delivers exceptional lifestyle benefits, combining the relaxed, coastal charm of Western Australia’s beaches with convenient free onsite parking and easy commuting access to the metropolitan amenities of Perth. MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Transform lives, every single day

Do you want a career that means more? At Anglicare Sydney, we bring the strength, the support and the strategy to make it happen.

We're a well-respected not-for-profit that's been serving society's most vulnerable for over 170 years. Each year, we achieve life-changing outcomes for more than 40,000 people who rely on our person-centred support. And now, we're extending our reach and impact even further.

As our Hub Coordinator - Brookvale Youth Mental Health Hub, you'll play a key leadership role in shaping an innovative, integrated mental health service for young people. You'll oversee the day-to-day operations of the Hub while leading a multidisciplinary team and working alongside partner organisations to ensure high-quality, accessible and coordinated care.

Be welcomed into a compassionate, respectful and purpose-driven community where we don't just talk about values-we live them.

Your opportunity

As our Hub Coordinator, you will lead the day-to-day operations of the Brookvale Youth Mental Health Hub, ensuring services are delivered safely, effectively and in line with funding agreements, clinical standards and organisational priorities.

Working closely with Anglicare teams, partner organisations, NSW Health and community stakeholders, you'll drive collaboration, oversee service delivery, support staff, monitor performance and champion continuous improvement.

With integrity and resilience, you will:

Lead the day-to-day operations of the Brookvale Youth Mental Health Hub.

Manage and support a multidisciplinary team while fostering a positive culture.

Ensure compliance with NSW Health funding agreements, KPIs and clinical governance.

Build strong partnerships with community organisations and stakeholders.

Drive service improvement, community engagement and innovative service delivery.

What you'll bring

You are an experienced and collaborative leader who is passionate about improving mental health outcomes for young people. You share our values of Integrity, Justice, Compassion and Excellence.

You will also need:

Tertiary qualifications in Social Work, Psychology, Counselling, Nursing or a related discipline.

Current registration-membership with the relevant professional body.

Leadership experience managing staff, programs or multidisciplinary services.

Experience managing funding agreements, reporting and KPIs.

Current unrestricted NSW Driver Licence and access to a comprehensively insured vehicle.

Ideally, you will also have:

Experience working in youth mental health services.

Strong understanding of clinical governance.

Experience building partnerships across health and community sectors.

Excellent stakeholder engagement skills.

Experience leading continuous improvement initiatives.

Why Anglicare?

We provide meaningful opportunities and choice, both for the individuals and communities we support and the dedicated people here who make it happen.

At Anglicare, you'll get the security, stability and opportunities that come with a strong, well-established organisation that's ready for the future. You'll belong to a community of kind, humble and respectful people of all faiths and backgrounds. You will also be supported to gain new knowledge, deepen your experience and expertise, and shape a rewarding career.

Salary packaging to increase your take-home pay.

Up to $2,650 tax free for meals and entertainment.

Ongoing professional development and leadership opportunities.

Employee Assistance Program and Fitness Passport.

Exclusive discounts with hundreds of retailers.

We're many services, with one purpose, to meet people where they are and walk with them. At Anglicare, we believe everyone is Made for Connection, with God, with each other, and with the places we call home. But sometimes, life unravels. That's where we step in, in Community and Mission, offering hope, support and presence. From food relief to chaplaincy, crisis care to caring for the wellbeing of the elderly, every moment of connection matters. And it's not just what we do. It's how we do it: side-by-side, with compassion and care.

The Cloud Systems Engineer is responsible for managing, supporting, and improving HammondCare's cloud and server infrastructure, ensuring secure,reliable, and efficient technology services across the organisation.

Design, manage, and optimise hybrid cloud infrastructure across Microsoft Azure and on-premises environments.

Administer and support Windows Server, Active Directory-Entra ID, virtualisation platforms, and core infrastructure services. 

Manage Azure resources, identity services, storage, networking, backup, and disaster recovery solutions. 

Provide Level 3 technical support, troubleshooting complex infrastructure and cloud-related issues. 

Lead and execute infrastructure upgrades, migrations, cloud adoption, and modernisation projects. 

Maintain security, patching, vulnerability management, compliance, and operational standards. 

Monitor infrastructure performance, availability, capacity, and resilience to ensure reliable service delivery. 

Manage enterprise file, print, SharePoint, backup, and business continuity services.

Develop and maintain technical documentation, standards, procedures, and architecture artefacts. 

Collaborate with internal teams, vendors, and service providers while supporting change, incident, and problem management processes.

Referral bonuses

Career and professional development opportunities

Commitment to HammondCare's Christian Mission and values. 

Bachelor's degree in information technology (or related field), or equivalent practical experience. 

3-5 years' experience in a Cloud Systems Engineer, Infrastructure Engineer, or similar role. 

Experience designing and supporting enterprise infrastructure, cloud platforms, and technology solutions. 

Strong expertise in Microsoft Azure, hybrid cloud infrastructure, Windows Server, virtualisation (VMware-Hyper-V), and Microsoft 365. 

Experience managing identity, security, networking, SharePoint, storage, backup, disaster recovery, and business continuity solutions. 

Strong skills in infrastructure security, patching, vulnerability management, automation (PowerShell-Python), and troubleshooting. 

Excellent communication, stakeholder management, customer service, and project delivery capabilities.
